items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: Mary Fettig off the top of my head is about the only one I can think of that was a female musician that actually played in the Stan Kenton Orchestra.

ctx.x: And I’ve always kind of wanted to do that. I’ve always tried to do things — what I — in my mind at least is the right way. You know it was — I mean obviously, and again I keep going back to the Kenton thing but that’s just ‘cause that was kind of the one that established these things. If you’re going to do a Stan Kenton reunion you’re going to be very short on African-American musicians, you’re going to be very short on female musicians. Now there are some, and we include them, as far as female musicians I mean…

It does make sense. We have a kind of event here every year that I organize and sometimes it’s much like a jazz party where I call one person and I say, “Bring a band. Bring whoever you would like.” What I don’t say or have a hard time saying is: it would be a plus if it was a diverse quintet and I find that hard to say.
